newsitem.title: POLAND: KREDYT BANK SETS ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 8.
newsitem.headline: KREDYT BANK SETS ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 8.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank SA has set the issue price of its 10-million-share public offering and 847,000-share offering for the EBRD at eight zlotys per share, the bank said in an abreviated version of its issue prospectus.
The public offering is divided into two tranches with two million shares going in a retail tranche and eight million shares in a large-investor tranche, both from April 7 to 11.
The EBRD will be offered between 635,000 and 847,000 shares on April 28 and April 29.

Kredyt Bank said in the prospectus its 1997 net profit should rise to 30.7 million zlotys from 23.2 million zlotys in 1996 and its revenues from interest should grow to 288.5 million zlotys from 252.1 million in 1996.
